gloss: start of summer; first day of summer (solar term)

definitions.gloss: start of summer; beginning of summer (solar term)
definitions.explanation: One of the 24 solar terms (二十四節気) in the traditional East Asian calendar. Falls around May 5-6 in the modern calendar, marking the traditional beginning of summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立夏|りっか}だ。
examples.english: Today is the start of summer.

examples.japanese: {立夏|りっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After the start of summer, the sunlight gets stronger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立夏|りっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{肌寒|はだざむ}い→肌寒い：13957_hadazamui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Although the calendar says summer has begun, the chilly days continue.

notes:
One of the 24 solar terms (⟦{二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}→二十四節気：25146_nijuushisekki⟧) that divide the year based on the sun's position. {立夏|りっか} falls around May 5-6 each year and marks the traditional beginning of summer, though actual temperatures in Japan at this time are still mild.

THE FOUR "BEGINNING" SOLAR TERMS:
- ⟦{立春|りっしゅん}→立春：22417_risshun⟧: start of spring (~February 4)
- {立夏|りっか}: start of summer (~May 5)
- ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧: start of autumn (~August 7)
- ⟦{立冬|りっとう}→立冬：26312_rittou⟧: start of winter (~November 7)

FORMS:
{立|りつ} (to stand, to begin) + {夏|か} (summer)

USAGE:
Often appears in weather forecasts and seasonal greetings. The phrase ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立夏|りっか} ("according to the calendar it's the start of summer") acknowledges that the astronomical date doesn't always match actual weather conditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立夏|りっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach the start of summer
- {立夏|りっか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}: seasonal greeting for early May
